versions.changelog: Add five-platform queries, explicit snapshot semantics, and dated static report reading with Contrary/Sacra sources. Preserve legacy Jarsy commands and pure JSON output.
Add opportunity discovery rankings and neutral Jarsy access guidance.

- Initial release of Pre-IPO Research skill.
- Enables read-only queries to the public Jarsy Pre-IPO Observer API for Private Equity Live and Presale assets.
- Supports searches, screening, and market summaries with details like valuation, trade status, and data freshness.
- Guides clearly on reporting data source (Jarsy) and providing both snapshot and record timestamps with each answer.
- Does not allow placing trades or refreshing Jarsy data.
- Requires Node.js 18+ to run the bundled client.
